patterns.note: Content sections are presented as full-width grayscale images, each followed by a numbered caption and a brief description, creating a sequential, gallery-like experience.

A highly distinctive, blocky, pixelated display font is used for all major headings and numerical labels, creating a strong visual identity that contrasts with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text.
The design employs a stark, high-contrast color palette, primarily using a vibrant, almost neon red as an accent color against a monochromatic grayscale background for all imagery and most text.
The initial hero title dynamically transforms on scroll, shrinking significantly and repositioning from a large, central display to a persistent, smaller header element in the top-left corner.
Content sections, consisting of image-text pairs, reveal sequentially as the user scrolls down the page, appearing to slide up into the viewport.
Each content item is structured as a full-bleed image, followed by a large, blocky number and a concise textual description, forming a consistent module for presenting information.

technique_notes: The hero title is implemented with a scroll-triggered transformation, where its font size and position animate to a smaller, fixed header state as the user scrolls past the initial viewport.
Content sections are revealed using a scroll-based animation, where each section appears to slide or fade up into view as it enters the viewport, creating a staggered reveal effect.

A sticky navigation element remains visible in the top right corner, and a distinct, full-width red footer section with 'Back to top' functionality appears to stick to the bottom of the viewport once the main content is scrolled past.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, blocky display headings (~4-5x body) and large numbers, contrasted with a clean, smaller sans-serif for body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout all elements, contributing to a stark aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major content blocks and a more compact arrangement for image-text pairs.

standout: The site's design is highly distinctive for its bold, almost brutalist aesthetic, achieved through the striking combination of a vibrant, almost neon red with stark grayscale photography. The unique pixelated display font for headings and numbering, coupled with the dynamic transformation of the hero title into a persistent header, creates a memorable and unconventional user experience that feels both modern and archival.
